panels.prompt: Medium shot: new plates of salt crust grow over giant figure crusted in white salt crystal, glowing blue eyes, chain whip, huge pick-hammer, like armor; salt boulders fall from cracking salt vault. Bone-white, cold blue.

Medium shot: air and dust streams sucked into salt giant's chest, crust opening in glowing cracks; young chinese woman, long black braid, dark-blue outfit, glowing white bow silently raises open hand as signal. Cold blue.

Wide action: young witcher man, short ash-grey hair, golden cat eyes, half-asian face, stubble, dark leather armor, two swords on back and three companions strike salt giant's opened chest at once: glowing sword, axe, white light arrow, steel; giant crashes to knees, floor cracking.
Extreme close-up: steel sword shears three fingers off salt-crusted giant hand gripping chain whip; shackle-link whip flies into darkness, salt chips. Cold blue.
Medium shot: salt crust sloughs off giant in great sheets, revealing raw grey salt-cured dead flesh; jets of brine burst through cracked walls. Bone-white, cold blue.

Wide shot: crustless gaunt grey giant kneels roaring; dark brine knee-deep, rising; salt vault splitting, boulders falling; young witcher man, short ash-grey hair, golden cat eyes, half-asian face, stubble, dark leather armor, two swords on back centre, sword ready, three companions beside him.
